doc_sources: Justlounge_Magento_2_Catalog_API_information.pdf (2 pages, Google Docs export, title 'Justlounge.com Magento 2 Catalog Data API'), including 2 embedded Postman screenshots

DOC-01.details: Doc covers only 2 catalogue GETs (category-wise products, all products). No order, status, tracking, returns or reconciliation endpoint anywhere.

DOC-02.details: No request/response examples in text; only Postman screenshots cut off at line 15 of the response (extension_attributes.website_ids).

DOC-03.details: Response shows status: 1, visibility: 4, type_id: simple, attribute_set_id: 4 with no explanation of values.

DOC-04.details: No date, version or owner in the doc. PDF metadata only gives the title.

AUTH-01.details: OAuth 1.0 with HMAC-SHA1 and four values (consumer key/secret, access token/secret) stated. Where the OAuth params go (Authorization header vs URL) is not stated; the Postman screenshot uses 'Request Body / Request URL'.

AUTH-02.details: A pre-issued access token is handed over; its lifetime is not stated. A Postman tab 'Get Token Based on OA...' is visible in the screenshot but not documented.

AUTH-03.live_notes: No staging credentials; production not called.

AUTH-04.live_notes: No staging credentials; production not called.

AUTH-05.details: Signing is standard OAuth 1.0 (RFC 5849) HMAC-SHA1, named on both pages; Postman screenshots show the exact configuration producing 200 OK.

ENV-01.details: Only https://justlounge.com (the live storefront) is given. No sandbox/staging URL or separate credentials.
ENV-01.live_notes: No staging environment exists in the doc.

ENV-05.details: No country or currency stated anywhere; price field has no currency.

CAT-01.details: GET /rest/V1/products with searchCriteria filter on category_id (example category 23); GET /rest/V1/products?searchCriteria[pageSize]=10 for all products.
CAT-01.live_notes: Vendor screenshots show 200 OK (766 ms, 37.32 KB) on PRODUCTION; we did not call production and no staging exists.

CAT-02.details: Only searchCriteria[pageSize]=10 is shown. Page selection (currentPage) and the end-of-list signal (total_count) are not documented.

CAT-03.details: Each item has id and sku (e.g. FR25846371H), but there is no order API, so we cannot confirm the sku is what an order would take.
CAT-03.live_notes: No order API to test against.

CAT-04.details: Visible: id, sku, name, price, status, type_id, created_at, updated_at. Not shown: currency, image, description, brand (screenshot truncated).

CAT-05.details: Only a type_id 'simple' item is shown; configurable products/variants not described.

CAT-06.details: No stock field or stock endpoint documented.

CAT-11.details: Each SKU carries a single fixed price (e.g. price: 910). Fixed price per SKU.

CAT-12.details: Category filtering by category_id exists; per-product category, T&C, usage and country fields not shown.

CAT-15.details: updated_at is present on items, but filtering by it is not documented.

CAT-16.details: Brand, image and description attribute codes are not listed.

PRC-01.details: price 910 shown with no statement whether it is our buy price, retail price, tax-inclusive, or includes shipping.

PRC-02.details: No currency code in the response or doc.

SEC-03.details: OAuth 1.0 parameters may be sent in the URL (screenshot setting 'Request Body / Request URL'); header-only not stated.

SEC-07.details: The PDF and both screenshots contain all four live OAuth values (consumer key/secret, access token/secret) in plain text for the production store. Found by scan_secrets.py; values deliberately not reproduced here.

SEC-08.details: Scope of the Magento integration user is not stated. A Magento integration token can carry admin-level resource access.

SUP-03.details: Paths use Magento /rest/V1/ versioning; no deprecation policy stated.

SUP-05.details: Postman was used (screenshots of workspace 'RESTful API Basics #blueprint'), but the collection itself was not shared.
